overview.title: ZroImg documentation
overview.description: Learn how image and video generation, the infinite canvas and credits work in ZroImg, and integrate generation into your own apps with the open API.

sectionDescriptions.guide: New to ZroImg? Start with the introduction and quickstart, then learn how credits are charged.
sectionDescriptions.api: Before you call the API, learn about authentication, the async task model, idempotency, rate limits and errors.
sectionDescriptions.endpoints: Parameters, responses and ready-to-run cURL, Python and JavaScript examples for every endpoint.

notices.title: Announcements & FAQ
notices.description: Latest announcements and frequently asked questions maintained by the ZroImg team.
